name: Claude Code
summary: Sends usage metrics (latency, reliability, usage patterns; no code, prompts or file paths) to Anthropic and third-party logging infrastructure. Sends error reports (stack traces, with redaction) to a third-party error tracker, on by default only for Pro, Max and Ultra sign-ins on v2.1.198 or later that connect directly to the Claude API. Metrics are off by default on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry.

optOut.instructions: Set CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1 to turn off metrics, error reports and surveys at once. Individually: DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 turns off metrics, DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING=1 turns off error reports. These variables can also be put in the env block of ~/.claude/settings.json.
